Figure with figcaption preserves both image and caption

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<figure><img src=\"sunset.jpg\" alt=\"A sunset\"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset over the ocean</figcaption></figure>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
